arrivalEssentials: Check current visa waiver, K-ETA, and health screening rules before you fly because entry processes can change at short notice.
Decide whether the AREX train or a taxi is better for your arrival time, hotel location, and luggage.
Set up a payment card, T-money option, or a little KRW for trains, convenience stores, and smaller purchases.
Sort mobile data early so maps, messaging, and local transport apps work the moment you leave the airport.

options.mode: AREX Express or All Stop Train
options.bestFor: Predictable access into Seoul without road traffic
options.notes: The express train is fastest to Seoul Station, while the all-stop option is cheaper and useful for some transfers.

options.bestFor: Direct drops near major hotel districts
options.notes: A good middle ground when you want fewer transfers but do not need a taxi.

options.bestFor: Late arrivals, families, or lots of luggage
options.notes: Fares vary by destination, traffic, and tolls, so check the route before you leave the rank.

entryRequirements.passportValidity: Use a passport with at least 6 months validity remaining to avoid airline or border issues.
entryRequirements.visaSummary: For Australian tourists, South Korea currently allows short stays without a visa and without applying for K-ETA through 31 December 2026, but always confirm the latest rules before departure.
entryRequirements.arrivalCardOrDeclaration: If you develop symptoms and are arriving from an area subject to quarantine inspection requirements, be ready to complete the Korean Q-code process or an arrival health questionnaire.
entryRequirements.officialSourceNote: Check the official K-ETA site and the current Australian Smartraveller advice for South Korea right before travel.
importantNotes: Entry and health screening settings can change quickly, especially around public health measures.
If you are a dual national or travelling on a long-stay status, your requirements may differ from standard tourist entry.

businessEtiquette.summary: Business meetings in South Korea usually reward punctuality, preparation, and a respectful tone, especially in first interactions.
tips: Arrive on time and keep introductions polite and professional.
Offer and receive business cards with care rather than treating them casually.
Keep early meetings measured and respectful even when the agenda is ambitious.

foodAndPracticalities.tapWater: Tap water is treated, but many visitors still prefer filtered water or bottled water for day one comfort.
foodAndPracticalities.tipping: Tipping is generally not expected in ordinary cafes, taxis, or restaurants.
foodAndPracticalities.dietaryNotes: Korean food can include hidden seafood, broth, or spice, so ask clearly if you have dietary restrictions.
foodAndPracticalities.commonFoodTips: Convenience stores are a practical fallback for snacks, drinks, transit card top-ups, and quick late-night food.
usefulPhrases: An maepge hae juseyo. (Please make it not spicy.)
Kadeu dwaeyo? (Can I pay by card?)

moneyAndPayments.conversion: Check live rates before travel; AUD 1 often lands around KRW 900 to 950.
moneyAndPayments.cardAcceptance: Cards are widely accepted in cities, transport hubs, hotels, and most chain cafes or restaurants.
moneyAndPayments.cashNotes: Keep a little cash for small vendors, older market stalls, or backup situations.
moneyAndPayments.tipping: Not usually expected beyond exceptional service at higher-end venues.
roughCostExamples: Beer at a casual venue: about KRW 5,000 to 9,000 (AUD 6 to 10)
Simple meal: about KRW 9,000 to 15,000 (AUD 10 to 17)
AREX into Seoul: about KRW 4,500 to 11,000 (AUD 5 to 12)

localTransportApps.name: Kakao T
localTransportApps.notes: Often the easiest way to book a ride without negotiating pickup details on the street.

localTransportApps.name: Naver Map
localTransportApps.notes: Usually more reliable for local routing in Korea than some global mapping apps.

emergencyNumbers.label: Police
notes: Call 112 for police help and 119 for fire or ambulance services.
English interpretation support is commonly available for emergency calls.

disclaimer: Sample briefing only. Entry rules, health requirements, and transport conditions can change; always confirm current details with official sources before you travel.

communications.networkWhy: Best overall network for travellers thanks to consistently strong speeds, broad national coverage, and dependable service on intercity rail routes.
